callouts.text:
28 USD DECLINE IN 2H20
THE MOVE IT EXISTS TO CATCH

6 ENTRIES HERE
LONG SHORT LONG SHORT

points: Eleven entries in four hours — roughly 66 a day, five short and six long. Six of them landed inside a 6.5 USD box in the final 100 minutes, alternating long-short-long-short. That is a whipsaw signature, not a signal.
The 28 USD slide from 17:00 to 19:20 is exactly the move a channel breakout exists to catch. It took at least two longs into it, near 4,357.8 and 4,356.2 — buying bounces against a falling channel.

Gold is a genuinely better venue than EURUSD. Its 1m bars run about 2.6× larger relative to price (1.10 bp vs 0.42 bp) and its spread is roughly half in bp terms, so spread eats ~63% of a 1m bar here against 333% on EURUSD — about 5× kinder.

Still not enough. At a 0.30 spread and 66 trades a day you pay ~20 USD into gold's ~55 USD daily range: 36% of everything available. You want that under 10%, which means 15m–1h — the same conclusion as EURUSD.
